payload.claim: Criteria 2 and 3's witnesses were argued by reading rather than run against a prototype. The spec's own linked evidence file (docs/evidence/2026-11-02-spec-chain-feedback.md) states the writer ran only criterion 4's whole-cell arrangement against a prototype and argued the other two. Criterion 2's witness spans a large matrix (4 spec types x 3 tier routes x 2 estimate values x 2 test-path policies) and criterion 3's witness depends on exact substring matching across two rendered messages under two policies; neither was executed against a draft of the change to confirm it behaves as claimed. My own reading found the described shapes coherent and plausible, but this is an acknowledged, unclosed verification gap a person should weigh before the cell starts.
